description: LUYDAL crystallizes in the monoclinic crystal system with space group P 21/n. Reported CIF formula moiety: C94 H112 Lu3 N3 O14 S10,2(C2 H3 N1),C5 H5 N1,4(H2 O1). From the CIF bond table, Lu2 (Lu) has 6 O neighbors; Lu2B (Lu) has 6 O neighbors; Lu1? (Lu) has 0 O neighbors. Oxygen-bridged metal-site graph: 1 pairs, 2 components; largest component is a chain with insufficient metal sites for a 3D shape classification. Computed bridged metal-metal separations span 5.132-5.132 Å (not direct metal-metal bonds). Computed M-O-M angles span 180.00-180.00°; individual values and O labels are in metal_framework.links. Article card reports molecular formula C94H112Lu3N3O14S10·2(MeCN)·py·4(H2O). Explicit grouped units in the article formula/name: 1 H2O (explicit grouped unit in article formula).
interpretation_limit: Oxidation states, nuclearity, oxo/hydroxo bridging, core charge and ligand identities/counts require article/SI or manual verification; atom-site counts are asymmetric-unit counts, not molecular stoichiometry. Graph topology is limited to identity-symmetry bonds in the CIF table. Approximate shape is based only on bridge-unwrapped metal-site coordinates in the largest component; symmetry-related bonds or periodic structures require manual crystallographic review. Empirical formulas alone do not establish unique oxidation-state assignments or ligand connectivity; annotations above reproduce explicit structural notation only.
